D: A runaway St Bernard puppy moves in with the Newtons, grows enormous, wrecks the house, and wins over everyone except Dad.
P: Bring out the burgers when Beethoven wrecks George's barbecue for the Wilsons.
S: Beethoven barks along to the Fifth

Rub the butter into the flour with a pinch of salt, then stir in the milk to a soft dough. Roll out to a 30 x 40cm rectangle, spread with tomato paste and scatter with cheese, chives and oregano. Roll up from the long side, cut into 12 rounds and pack into a lined tin. Bake at 200C until puffed and golden.
Sparky's mini corn dogs with tomato sauce

Whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder and salt, then whisk in the egg and milk to a thick batter. Pat the franks dry and push a skewer into each. Pour the batter into a tall glass, dip each frank and fry at 180C until deep golden. Drain and serve with tomato sauce.
M: Season the mince well and shape into 4 patties a little wider than the buns. Stir the mayonnaise, tomato sauce and mustard into burger sauce. Grill or barbecue the patties 3 to 4 minutes a side, laying the cheese on for the last minute. Toast the buns and build with sauce, lettuce, tomato, patty and pickles.
Brad and Brie's three-cheese mac with crunchy crumbs
The ride Brad and Brie deserved

Cook the macaroni 2 minutes short of the packet time and drain. Melt the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the milk and simmer until thick. Stir in the cheeses until melted, then fold through the pasta and tip into a baking dish. Scatter with the panko and paprika and bake at 200C until golden and bubbling.
W: Late-night giant choc chip skillet cookie

Whisk the melted butter with both sugars, then beat in the egg and vanilla. Stir in the flour, bicarb and a pinch of salt, then the chocolate chips. Press into a buttered 25cm ovenproof frying pan and bake at 180C until golden at the edges and soft in the middle. Cool for 5 minutes and serve straight from the pan with scoops of ice cream.
K: Beethoven saves Emily at the pool

Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, then stir in the sugar and chill. Fill 4 glasses with ice and pour in the blue tea and the soda. Pour the lemon juice in at the table and watch it turn purple.
